verdict.rationale: jo documents a set of first-party wired-up integrations (GitHub, Linear, Slack-style channel catchup, decks) that users connect so jo can work with their connected context. That is the product's own connector capability. There is no evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps that a user can pick from and add. Missing for 10: a browsable in-product connector directory, an open third-party app or marketplace ecosystem, documented add/connect flow steps, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: jo works with your connected context to help with the messages, schedules, projects, and follow-ups you are carrying.
